【What happens if ETH breaks below 2300】

I’ve thought about this.

Not in the sense of “guessing”—it’s the mindset of someone building an actual business: think through the worst case first, then see whether it’s worth betting on.

That support level, $ 2323, isn’t drawn at random. Look at how far ETH has retraced from its highs—over 50%. That number is interesting. Historically, when mainstream assets fall into the “halving” range, long-term capital starts moving in to pick up the pieces. This isn’t about bottom-fishing; it’s about allocation.

But this time there’s a variable I haven’t seen before—Deutsche Bank. Germany’s largest bank is waiting for regulatory approval to provide institutional custody for BTC, ETH, and stablecoins. This is real—not rumor.

I thought carefully about what that implies.

When institutions move in, the first problem they need to solve is: “Where is my crypto safe?” Custody services are the answer. Previously, this was something only crypto-focused companies like Coinbase and BitGo handled. Now traditional banking giants are coming in. What does that mean? They bring reputational backing, compliance frameworks, and established institutional relationship networks.

So what does it mean? It means there will likely be a large wave of institutional capital that previously wanted to enter but didn’t know how—now willing to hold ETH because they trust Deutsche Bank. ETH stops being only a pool of retail funds and protocol liquidity, and starts becoming an asset class recognized by traditional finance.

Of course, I also noticed the wallet-standard issue. EIP-8141 and EIP-8130 are taking separate paths, so cross-chain wallet developers have to support two sets of logic. But honestly, in the face of institutional custody, that’s not as high a priority. Protocol-layer matters can be worked through slowly. As for ecosystem acceptance: once mainstream banks start holding it, the balance of power changes.

The sentiment index is currently Neutral, and slightly low. But precisely because it’s low, it suggests everyone is watching and waiting. Big moves never come when everyone’s confidence is at its peak.

What am I watching? Right now I’m watching trading volume—if one day it suddenly expands to coincide with a breakout beyond $ 2500, I’ll seriously consider that this means the situation has changed.

#ETH #加密分析 #Market Insights

content:
【如果ETH跌破2300会发生什么】

我想过这个问题。

不是YY，而是做实业的习惯——先想最坏情况，再看值不值得押注。

$ 2323这个支撑，不是随便画的。你去看ETH从高点回撤了多少？超过50%。这个数字有意思。历史上，主流资产在腰斩这个区间，长线资金就开始进场捡了。不是抄底，是配置。

但这次有个变量我没见过——Deutsche Bank。德意志银行，德国最大的银行，正在等监管批准给机构提供BTC、ETH和稳定币托管。真实发生的事，不是传闻。

我仔细想了这事意味着什么。

机构进场，第一步要解决的是"我的币放哪安全"的问题。托管服务就是答案。以前这事只有 Coinbase、BitGo 这种专门干加密的公司在做，现在传统银行巨头进来了。它们有信用背书，有合规框架，有现成的机构关系网络。这意味着什么？

意味着未来会有大量"以前想进但不知道怎么进"的机构资金，因为信任德意志银行而愿意持有ETH。ETH不再只是散户和协议的资金池，开始成为传统金融认可的资产类别。

当然，wallet标准的事我也注意到了。EIP-8141和EIP-8130各走各的路，跨链的钱包开发者要多头处理两套逻辑。但这事说实话，在机构托管面前，优先级没那么高。协议层的事，慢慢磨。生态接受度这事，一旦主流银行开始持有了，话语权就不一样了。

情绪指数现在Neutral，偏低。但正因为偏低，才说明大家在观望。真正的大行情从来不是在大家信心满满时来的。

你盯什么？我现在盯的是成交量——如果某天突然放大配合突破$ 2500，我会认真考虑这件事的意义变了。

资金费率0.0063%，几乎躺平。什么意思？杠杆多头没上头，空头也没押注，全市场都在等一个方向。这种时刻最怕什么？最怕你以为的突破，其实是给别人递刀。

ETH倒是有点意思：2441.68的价格贴着日线卖点2443.26反复摩擦，费率还是负的-0.0007%。价格逼近阻力、杠杆却不敢跟，典型的口嫌体正直——嘴上谨慎，仓位很诚实。夜盘站稳2443，上看2453.33这个今日高点；站不稳，就回2378找支撑，那是日线买点，也是市场提前划好的重点。

夜盘剧本就三条：
1. BTC放量啃下76801，上方趋势确认，76750的前高顺手改写；
2. 啃不动也别慌，回踩75286之前都算健康整理，跌破75286才是多头的脸被打肿；
3. 万一情绪崩了，75025今天的低点就是最后一层垫子。

XRP持有人别急着反驳，1.2989的价格在1.26和1.33之间晃了一整天，涨0.286%，这叫行情吗？这叫横店特效。

方向：偏多。逻辑不复杂——四个币没一个收绿，BTC收在枢轴上方，费率没过热，下方75286有承接。但偏多不等于无脑，76801过不去之前，所有涨幅都是试用期。次日只要75913不丢，结构就没坏；丢了，再谈风险不迟。

夜里就盯两件事：BTC对76801的态度，ETH对2443的执念。突破了别追高，等回踩确认；跌破了别乱，轴点就是给你划的重点。市场从不缺机会，缺的是没被情绪带偏的手。

subTitle:
值得盯的是产品流，不是再复读一遍宏观标题。

美东时间9月16日，美现货\$ETH ETF合计净流出约2.241亿美元（Farside终值；SoSoValue口径约2.24亿）。BlackRock ETHA约-1.10亿领跑，Fidelity FETH约-5560万，ETHB约-1980万、ETHV约-1400万、Grayscale ETHE约-1390万、21Shares TETH约-1080万——当日活跃资金流几乎全线净赎回。

对比一下节奏：9月14日\$ETH侧还刚录得约+1.211亿反弹；随后两日合计赎回约3.664亿。PANews援引SoSoValue：累计净流入仍约131.46亿，AUM约151.55亿，ETF净资产占比约5.15%。

我的判断：这是ETF wrapper边际需求在降温，不是\$ETH“归零叙事”。单日产品流会鞭子抽，别把它当成中长期供需的终局。\$BTC侧同日也有大幅流出，但那是另一条产品线，今天只筛\$ETH这一刀。

数据来源：Farside Investors（FinanceFeeds整理）、SoSoValue（PANews）。不构成投资建议。

Lately, I’ve been lurking around the charts, and my mood has never been truly smooth or at ease. There’s no total wipeout panic, nor have I given up and sprawled out. What remains is endless entanglement, regret, and self-consuming mental drain—quietly eroding my mindset.

After spending time in this industry, I finally understand that the hardest part of trading isn’t analyzing price levels or spotting trends, but holding steady in one’s mentality and strictly following discipline. Most losses never come from the market not offering opportunities; they come from losing to one’s own emotions.

During this period, my mindset has been especially restless. Even though I set trading rules in advance and defined take-profit/stop-loss standards, when facing the ups and downs of the market, it’s still easy to lose control. Profitable trades can’t be held—when I get a small gain, I panic and exit too quickly. If I’m caught in a position, I start to hold on with wishful thinking, stubbornly refusing to stop. I’m unwilling to take a small stop-loss, and in the end I drag a small loss into a big one.

What torments me most isn’t the loss itself, but the repeated self-blame afterward. I miss out on行情 I can read because of greed. I hesitate and fantasize even when I know a breakdown has occurred. I keep making emotional, impulsive trades and blind guesses, repeating the same mistakes again and again until my patience and confidence are exhausted.

The market is always cold and fair. It never caters to people’s unwillingness or their luck. All losses are loopholes in mindset and discipline. Let go of the obsession with getting rich overnight, quit the bad habit of impulsively opening positions, don’t rush to get back to even, and don’t trade too frequently.

In the crypto world, gains and losses are always the norm, and downturns are also part of growth. Going forward, stabilize your mindset and keep your hands under control. Seek progress while staying steady—slow is stability, stability is winning. #zec #BTC #ETH #Mindset determines the outcome

However, ETF #xrp  became one of the categories with the largest inflow size among crypto ETFs that day. This suggests that some institutional attention to XRP has not completely disappeared just because the bill was blocked.

Regulatory developments are also worth watching

SEC Chair Paul Atkins said that even if the CLARITY Act does not pass, the SEC will continue to push forward crypto regulation within its existing statutory authority. CFTC Chair Michael Selig also said institutions are ready to continue drafting relevant rules.

This implies the market may be gradually shifting from waiting for congressional legislation to first seeing how regulators move forward.

However, XRP currently has one fairly clear pressure point.

XRP open interest has fallen from about $1.128 billion in August to roughly $871 million. OI on both Binance and Bybit has declined in tandem.

This indicates that leverage in the derivatives market is being reduced significantly. So XRP’s rise can’t be understood purely as money fully returning; more importantly, we need to watch whether spot ETF inflows can keep up, and when derivatives capital will return.

On the technical side, XRP is still in a fairly key position.

According to the article, XRP is around $1.30—still below the 200-week EMA of about $1.36. If it can reclaim $1.36, attention can again be placed on the $1.52 area above.

Conversely, if the price action keeps weakening, the market should watch the support region around $1.04.

So what’s most worth watching for XRP right now isn’t whether the CLARITY Act will pass immediately, but rather three things: whether ETF capital inflows can continue, whether the SEC and CFTC can continue advancing regulation within existing authority, and whether XRP’s price can reclaim $1.36.

If all three signals start improving at the same time, the market’s XRP pricing logic may change again.

title: 众议院筹款委员会 38–5：加密税确定性法案推进，洗售规则写进草案
subTitle:
值得盯的不是再复盘市场结构卡壳，而是另一条轨道动了：税收。

9月16日，美国众议院筹款委员会（Ways and Means）以 38–5 通过 H.R. 10357《Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act》。主席 Jason Smith 会后表示，这将是首部系统处理加密等数字资产实体税则的联邦立法——前提仍是整部法案最终成法。

刺点在 wash-sale（洗售规则）：若成法，对 2026年9月14日之后卖出的交易型数字资产（合格美元稳定币除外），若在卖出前后 30 天内买回相同或实质相同资产，亏损不得计入税前抵扣。等于把股票那套纪律往加密上套。

配套还包括：部分规则向股票/证券靠拢、小额豁免、券商报告扩大、挖矿与质押奖励按普通收入处理等（KPMG 对委员会 markup 摘要；Unchained 对洗售生效日拆解）。JCT 粗算数字资产相关条款十年约增收约 25 亿美元——以官方修订文本为准。

我的判断：市场结构立法在参院程序票卡住之后，众院税收这条线并没有停。委员会过关 ≠ 全院通过 ≠ 参院过关 ≠ 签字生效。但 wash-sale 一旦落地，短线「卖了又买回」的成本结构会变。

只筛选，不教育。不构成投资建议。

What’s worth watching isn’t getting stuck re-analyzing market structure—it’s another track that moved: taxation.

On September 16, the U.S. House Committee on Ways and Means passed H.R. 10357 (Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act) by a vote of 38–5. After the vote, Chair Jason Smith said this would be the first federal legislation to systematically address entity tax rules for digital assets such as crypto—assuming the entire bill ultimately becomes law.

Wash-sale rule: If enacted, losses from transactions in transaction digital assets (excluding eligible USD stablecoins) sold on or after September 14, 2026 will not be eligible for pre-tax offset if the same or substantially identical asset is repurchased within 30 days before or after the sale. It's essentially applying the stock-market discipline to crypto.

To be honest, the investment strategy for the next few years needs to be carefully re-planned.

That old approach from a few years ago no longer works. The era of holding mainstream crypto assets like #BTC  and #ETH  and just lying flat until massive returns arrive has already passed.

Back in 2019 and 2020, people all thought that baijiu and the consumer sector would remain strong forever.

No matter what asset or sector, there is a stage where tailwinds surge—and there will also be stretches of frustrating, grinding volatility. Sometimes even the underlying logic changes completely.

There really is no ever-lasting, unchanging “correct answer” in investing.

The logic that used to make money may not be something you can simply copy into the future.

In the market, there is no one category of asset that can simultaneously offer high certainty, high returns, and low risk. These three points are, in most cases, the “impossible triangle” of investing.

To chase higher returns, you have to withstand greater volatility and unknown risks. And if you want enough stability and peace of mind, you usually have to give up part of your expected returns.

So if you invest long enough, you’ll understand: it’s not about relentlessly searching for a one-and-done universal solution. Instead, you should continuously and dynamically adjust your asset allocation as the market environment evolves.

If your account only has a few hundred to a few thousand U right now, don’t fantasize about changing your life with a single trade.#ETH 

The real path for small capital growth has never been about gambling. It’s built up little by little. One of Yingge’s brothers started trading with 1500U. In the past, he liked going all-in—when price rose he chased it, when it fell he averaged down. In the end, the account got smaller and smaller. Later, he redrafted his rules. After 4 months, his account grew to 45,000U. What changed him were three trading principles.

First, always leave yourself a fallback.
Splitting your capital is traders’ greatest sense of security. A short-term position, a trend position, and a reserve position—each takes on a different task. This way, when market conditions change, one wrong trade won’t wipe out your chance to recover.

Second, only wait for high-quality opportunities.
The market isn’t worth trading every day. Participate less in ranging/choppy markets; don’t place trades unless a trend has been confirmed. The real money-makers are often not the people who trade the most, but the ones who wait the longest.

Third, keep emotions out of trading.
When you’re losing, don’t rush to get even. When you’re winning, don’t try to squeeze every last bit out of the move. Cut losses when you should, lock in profits when you should.

Many people don’t lose because of the market—they lose because of greed and fear.

For small capital to grow, the most important thing isn’t speed, but stability.

Your account can grow slowly, but the prerequisite is that you must stay in the market. Protect your principal—then you’ll have the right to wait for wealth growth.
#CryptoSurvivalRules

真正的小资金成长路径，
从来不是赌出来的，

资金分仓，是交易者最大的安全感。短线仓、趋势仓、备用仓，各自承担不同任务。这样面对行情变化，不会因为一笔错误操作失去翻身机会。

市场不是每天都值得交易。震荡行情少参与，趋势没有确认不下注。真正赚钱的人，往往不是操作最多的人，而是等待最久的人。

第三，把情绪赶出交易。
亏损时不要急着翻本，盈利时不要想着赚尽最后一波。该止损就止损，该兑现就兑现。

很多人输，不是输在行情，而是输在贪婪和恐惧。

小资金想成长，最重要的不是速度，而是稳定。

账户可以慢慢变大，但前提是你必须一直留在市场里。守住本金，才有资格等待财富增长。

⚡ Verify the entire system.

Instead of simply asking “Can defenders find the hacker first?”, Buterin’s vision asks a deeper question:

The Federal Reserve’s interest rate decision meeting in the early hours of last night finally came to a close, and the overall result fully matched market expectations: a 25-basis-point rate hike.
​​Although the hike was already expected, the post-meeting dot plot and Powell’s remarks were overall hawkish as well—this was the core reason why the market saw choppy, tug-of-war price action last night.
​​The officials’ stance was very clear overall: inflation remains stubborn, and there will be no easy loosening of monetary policy in the near term. By the end of the year, there is still a possibility of further hikes, and high interest rates will need to be maintained for a sustained period.
​​But many people were confused after seeing it last night:
If it’s a hawkish negative, why didn’t BTC immediately crash and collapse?
The key logic is actually simple: #ETH 
The rate hike had already been priced in by the market in advance!
There weren’t many surprises on the downside. So after the news was confirmed, the market didn’t continue to trigger another wave of major selloff.
​​The chart last night was very typical:
Right at the release of the decision, price quickly dipped, broke to a new low, flushing out a batch of short-term long positions and leveraged holdings;
Then funds moved in rapidly to repair and rebound, producing a classic back-and-forth wicking pattern with extremely volatile, range-bound trading.
​​There was no one-way crash, and no strong one-way rally—this was a standard news-driven “washout”/position-clearing market.
​​You could clearly see differences in market strength:
BTC’s movement was relatively steady, grinding back and forth within a range throughout;
ETH had higher volatility—the magnitude of its up-and-down swings last night was far more intense than BTC’s.
​​Let’s end with one more statement about the real market logic:
If a negative gets priced but price doesn’t fall, it’s a short-term sign of strength.
But don’t get blindly bullish either—the Fed has clearly maintained a hawkish stance, and the high-rate environment remains unchanged.

Your entry price—the market doesn't know, and it doesn't care.

It won’t move up just because your cost is somewhere. It also won’t stop falling just because you haven’t broken even yet.

The anchoring effect is exactly this: you take a number that has nothing to do with the market and treat it as a reason for where the price should go.

I was like this in my early days too. When it dropped, I would stare at my cost line, mentally repeating that I’d get out when it came back there. In the end, the market moved wherever it was going, and my cost stayed stuck there, unmoving.

The only question that really matters is: if I’m currently in cash, would I still buy this level?

If you can’t answer it, it means you’re guarding your own bookkeeping—not this coin.

Not investment advice.

以太坊市场深度解析：鲸鱼加仓与宏观逆境的拉锯战

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间九月十七日下午，以太坊现货报价二千四百四十点四七美元，过去五个小时在二千四百一十六美元至二千四百四十六美元区间内运行。从小时K线来看，价格从二千四百二十七美元逐步攀升至二千四百四十二美元后小幅回落，整体呈现震荡上行态势。

以太坊在过去二十四小时内反弹约百分之二，展现出相对独立于大盘的走强迹象。这一反弹发生在极为不利的宏观环境之下：美联储刚刚宣布加息至百分之四，参议院否决了数字资产市场清晰法案，加密市场整体承压。在此背景下，以太坊能够获得买盘支撑，主要得益于机构资金的持续流入。

链上数据显示，主要资产管理机构和鲸鱼钱包在过去数日内从交易所提取超过一万枚以太坊用于质押，显示出强烈的长期持有信心。德意志银行计划推出受监管的加密托管服务，进一步增强了机构入场的预期。然而，以太坊ETF在九月十六日录得二点二四一亿美元的净流出，显示部分机构仍在短期减仓，多空力量形成拉锯。

二、技术指标解读

从一小时级别技术指标来看，以太坊的多空力量略微偏向多头。十五个因子信号中，看多因子八个，看空因子七个，无中性因子，多头略占优势。综合指标发出看多信号，历史胜率为百分之七十六点一九，整体可靠性较高。

移动平均线系统呈现多头排列。七日均线二千四百三十二点五位于二十五日均线二千四百一十点八上方，且两者均向上运行，短期趋势明确偏多。九十九日均线二千四百六十四点九仍高于当前价格，构成中期阻力位。指数移动平均线同样确认七日均线上穿二十五日均线，七日EMA为二千四百三十一点四，二十五日EMA为二千四百一十九点六，多头格局稳固。

MACD指标表现积极，DIF线五点一七高于信号线负零点三零，柱状图连续五个周期保持正值，最新值为五点四七，多头动能持续释放。RSI六周期数值为六十九点二八，接近超买区域但尚未进入危险区间，短期仍有上行空间。十二周期RSI为六十一点八六，处于健康偏多区域。

布林带显示价格运行在中轨二千四百一十二点五与上轨二千四百四十七点六之间，带宽适中。当前价格距离上轨仅约七美元，短期面临上轨压力。若能有效突破二千四百四十八美元，有望打开进一步上行空间。KDJ指标中K值为八十三点二八，D值为七十九点一八，J值为九十一一点五零，三线均处于高位区域，提示短期存在回调需求。

抛物线SAR指标位于二千三百八十九点三，远低于当前价格，维持看多信号。SuperTrend指标在二千三百八十三点三，价格位于其上方，确认多头趋势。ATR十四周期为十九点五三，波动率较低，市场处于蓄势阶段。随机RSI从一百的极端高位回落至九十一一点五，超买修复正在进行中。

威廉指标显示当前读数为负十二点六一，处于超买区域，提示短期价格可能面临回调压力。但考虑到综合指标胜率较高且多头因子占优，回调幅度可能有限。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前的市场情绪可以用谨慎乐观来概括。从利好因素来看，鲸鱼地址持续从交易所提取以太坊用于质押，减少了市场流通供应量，为价格提供了有力支撑。Circle推出的Arc Layer 1主网以USDC作为原生Gas代币，首日即录得七百七十六万笔交易和近十亿美元的USDC转账量，贝莱德、DTCC和Visa担任验证节点，这为以太坊生态带来了积极的机构效应。

从利空因素来看，美联储加息至百分之四和CLARITY法案的失败构成了双重压力。紧缩的货币环境降低了风险资产的吸引力，而监管立法的受挫则增加了政策不确定性。以太坊ETF单日流出二点二四一亿美元，虽然规模小于比特币，但同样反映了部分机构的短期避险需求。

从技术面综合判断，以太坊在二千四百美元上方建立了相对稳固的支撑，多头指标整体占优但短期存在超买压力。若价格能有效突破布林带上轨二千四百四十八美元，有望向二千五百美元整数关口发起冲击；若回调，二千四百一十美元的七日均线将是第一道支撑，二千三百八十三美元的SuperTrend为强支撑位。

建议投资者关注鲸鱼地址的持续动向和ETF资金流向变化，在当前位置不宜追高，可等待回调至支撑位附近再考虑布局。中长期来看，机构托管服务的扩展和Layer 1基础设施的完善，为以太坊的价值增长提供了坚实基础。

Robinhood to Integrate Circle Arc Network

Robinhood announced it will soon support Arc, an L1 network built by Circle. Users will be able to directly deposit and withdraw USDC within the network range it supports. The key point here is that the brokerage and crypto on-ramp platforms are further integrating stablecoin transfer capabilities into a new chain aimed at institutional settlement, rather than simply adding another standard deposit/withdrawal channel.

By background, Arc was developed in-house by Circle. It is not positioned to compete for general DeFi liquidity, but as a settlement network for stablecoins, tokenized real-world assets, and foreign-exchange clearing. Available materials indicate that the Arc mainnet is planned to open on September 16, using USDC as the native gas. It also emphasizes deterministic finality: once the transaction is confirmed by the collective signatures of validators, it is considered final, without relying on multiple confirmations to reduce reorganization probability. This kind of design better matches the needs of clearing institutions for “irrevocable credentials.”

What needs to be unpacked is that Arc’s institutional-friendly attributes coexist with decentralization-related controversy. Its founding validators include institutions such as DTCC, ICE, Visa, Mastercard, BlackRock, and Standard Chartered, as well as Circle itself. The validator set is currently not fully open. Permissioned validators, blacklist mechanisms, audit trails, and USDC-based fees improve compliance and cost predictability, but they also mean the trust model differs from that of open public blockchains.

For the crypto market, Robinhood’s support for Arc will likely play out in three main ways: First, the USDC deposit/withdrawal entry point increases, which may improve users’ experience moving funds between trading platforms and the new settlement network. Second, if more wallets, exchanges, and applications integrate, stablecoin and RWA applications on Arc could gain smoother inflow channels. Third, the market previously linked the meme hype around Robinhood’s chain with Arc’s launch, but Arc’s initial positioning is more focused on institutional clearing; whether that kind of activity can migrate remains to be verified by real on-chain data.

My editorial take is that Robinhood’s integration is a positive signal for Arc’s ecosystem usability, but it does not mean Arc has completed the narrative of becoming a decentralized public chain, nor does it imply that on-chain speculation will necessarily be replicated. What’s more worth watching is whether USDC deposits and withdrawals remain stable after Arc goes live, whether applications truly generate settlement demand, and whether Circle later discloses a more open mechanism for adding validators. In the short term, this is a step toward expanding stablecoin infrastructure; in the medium term, it will be Arc’s ability to find a balance between compliance, efficiency, and openness that determines its market position.

content:
Robinhood将接入Circle Arc网络

Robinhood宣布即将支持Circle构建的L1网络Arc，用户可在其支持的网络范围内直接存入和提取USDC。这一消息的核心在于，券商与加密入口型平台正在把稳定币转账能力进一步接入面向机构结算的新链，而非单纯增加一条普通充提通道。

从背景看，Arc由Circle自研，定位并非争夺通用DeFi流动性的公链，而是服务稳定币、代币化现实世界资产与外汇清算的结算网络。相关资料显示，Arc主网计划于9月16日开放，采用USDC作为原生Gas，并强调确定性最终性：交易经验证人集体签名确认后即告定案，不再依赖多次确认来降低重组概率。这类设计更贴近清算机构对“不可撤销凭证”的需求。

需要拆开看的是，Arc的机构友好属性与去中心化争议并存。其创始验证人包括DTCC、ICE、Visa、Mastercard、BlackRock、Standard Chartered等机构以及Circle自身，验证人集合目前并非完全开放。许可制验证人、黑名单机制、审计轨迹和USDC计费，提升了合规与成本可预期性，但也意味着信任模型不同于开放公链。

对加密市场而言，Robinhood支持Arc的影响路径主要有三层：第一，USDC存取入口增加，可能改善用户在交易平台与新结算网络之间的资金移动体验；第二，若更多钱包、交易平台和应用接入，Arc上的稳定币与RWA应用会获得更顺畅的流入渠道；第三，市场此前曾将Robinhood链上的meme热度与Arc上线联系起来，但Arc的初始定位更偏机构清算，相关活跃能否迁移仍需实际链上数据验证。

编辑判断是，Robinhood的接入属于Arc生态可用性的正向信号，但不等于Arc已完成去中心化公链叙事，也不代表链上投机活动必然复制。更值得观察的是，Arc上线后USDC充提是否稳定、应用是否真正产生结算需求、以及Circle后续是否披露更开放的验证人加入机制。短期看，这是稳定币基础设施扩张的一步；中期看，Arc能否在合规、效率与开放性之间找到平衡，才决定其市场位置。

━━━ 最矛盾的信号 ━━━

FVG共识BULL，但OI全周期SHORT_BUILD，置信度100%。15M、1H、4H三个周期空头全部在加仓。CVD 1H=-101，卖方主导。有人在$76,500附近挂了3000万空单，这不是散户做得到的。

━━━ ETH才是真正的猎场 ━━━

期权市场也站队了。VolSkew=-4，IV溢价-9.6%，期权偏空。ETH比BTC更弱。

剧本A（52%）：破$77,925止损墙，逼空到$80,262

为什么系统判定WAIT我还敢做？9.12改革规则：FOMC后OI翻转+1H收阳＝临时方向确认，可覆盖score门控。系统说WAIT是因为score=55<140，但事件驱动条件满足时，门控可以被覆盖。

Crypto Futures Trading: Understanding the Basics Before You Trade 📊

Crypto Futures can look attractive because traders can potentially profit from both rising and falling markets. But Futures are fundamentally different from simply buying and holding cryptocurrency.

🔹 What Are Crypto Futures?

Futures are contracts whose value is linked to an underlying cryptocurrency such as BTC, ETH, BNB or SOL. Unlike spot buying, Futures can involve leverage, which can significantly increase both potential gains and potential losses.

🔹 Why Is Risk Higher?

Crypto prices can move quickly. With leverage, even a relatively small market movement can have a much larger impact on a Futures position.

That means:

📈 Market moves in your direction → position value can increase quickly
📉 Market moves against you → losses can also increase quickly
⚡ High volatility → conditions can change within a short period

🔹 Futures vs Spot

Spot: You purchase the actual cryptocurrency and generally hold it.

Futures: You trade a contract based on the cryptocurrency's price. Depending on the contract, you may be able to take either a long or short position.

🔹 The Most Important Lesson

Don't choose a position simply because a chart is moving up or down. A single chart cannot guarantee what happens next.

Before considering any Futures position, understand:

• Leverage
• Margin
• Liquidation
• Funding fees
• Position size
• Market volatility
• Your maximum acceptable loss

{spot}(ETHUSDT)
🧠 Final Thought

Futures trading is not a shortcut to guaranteed profits. Understanding the market and controlling risk is more important than trying to predict every price movement.

🚀 Building an algorithmic trading bot from scratch

I’ve been working for several weeks on a modular quantitative trading system in Python, initially focused on BTC/USD and ETH/USD.

The project already includes technical analysis, risk management, position sizing, LONG/SHORT, backtesting, simulation of fees/spread/slippage, real-time paper trading, position persistence, performance metrics, and statistical analysis.

We’re currently at a key stage: extended paper trading and validation with real market data, but without using real money.

First checkpoint: 37 closed trades.

📊 Initial baseline results:

Win rate: 13.51%
PnL: -2.70%
Max drawdown: 2.70%
Profit factor: 0.078

The numbers aren’t good yet, and that’s exactly what’s interesting: instead of tweaking the strategy until a backtest “looks pretty,” we’re studying why it loses, how much commissions matter, what happens in BTC vs ETH, LONG vs SHORT, and what effect the duration of trades has.

An initial observation: execution costs are having a huge impact, especially on short-duration trades.

The next goal is to reach 100 closed trades without changing the baseline, to get a more representative sample before optimizing anything.

For me, building a bot isn’t about finding a strategy that always wins. It’s about creating a system that can be measured, challenged, fail in a controlled way, and improve with evidence.

We keep building. 📈🤖

title: ترميز الأصول بالبلوكشين: كيف يعيد تشكيل الشركات والعقارات ودعم سوق الكريبتو
subTitle:
في عام 2026، لم يعد ترميز الأصول الحقيقية (RWA) مجرد مفهوم نظري أو اتجاه عابر. بلغت القيمة الإجمالية للأصول المرمزة على السلسلة نحو 31 مليار دولار بحلول منتصف 2026، وفقاً لبيانات RWA.xyz، مع توقعات بأن يصل السوق إلى 4 تريليونات دولار بحلول 2035. هذا التحول الهائل لا يقتصر على فئة واحدة من الأصول، بل يمتد من سندات الخزانة الأمريكية إلى العقارات والسلع وحتى الأسهم الخاصة. والسؤال الجوهري اليوم لم يعد "هل سيحدث الترميز؟" بل "كيف سيعيد تشكيل الأسواق المالية التقليدية، وما الذي يعنيه ذلك لمستقبل العملات الرقمية؟"
ما هو ترميز الأصول بالبلوكشين؟
ترميز الأصول هو عملية تحويل ملكية أصل مادي أو مالي إلى رموز رقمية (Tokens) مسجلة على شبكة بلوكشين. تمثل هذه الرموز حصصاً أو ملكية جزئية في الأصل الأساسي، مما يسمح بتداولها بشكل مشابه لتداول الأسهم أو العملات الرقمية. الفكرة الجوهرية هي تجزئة الملكية: بدلاً من امتلاك مبنى كامل أو سند خزينة بقيمة مليون دولار، يمكن للمستثمر شراء جزء صغير يبدأ من بضع عشرات الدولارات.
القيمة المضافة هنا ليست مجرد التجزئة. البلوكشين يوفر شفافية كاملة وسجلاً غير قابل للتلاعب للملكية والمعاملات، وسيولة محسّنة عبر إمكانية التداول على مدار الساعة، وكفاءة تشغيلية من خلال العقود الذكية التي تقلل الحاجة للوسطاء وتختصر زمن التسوية من أيام أو أسابيع إلى دقائق.
ترميز الشركات والعقارات: الواقع الحالي
سندات الخزانة: فئة الأصول الناضجة الوحيدة
إذا كان هناك فئة أصول واحدة أثبتت جدارتها في الترميز، فهي بلا منازع سندات الخزانة الأمريكية. بلغت قيمة الدين المرمّز لسندات الخزانة نحو 15 مليار دولار عبر 100 أصل، مع 99% منها قابلة للنقل على بلوكشين عامة. المنتجات الرئيسية في هذه الفئة تشمل USYC من Circle، وUSDY من Ondo Finance، وiBENJI من Franklin Templeton، وWTGXX من WisdomTree.
ما يجعل سندات الخزانة مثالية للترميز هو أنها أدوات مالية بسيطة نسبياً، ذات عائد واضح (عادة 3-5%)، وطلب مؤسسي هائل. قال لاري فينك، الرئيس التنفيذي لـ BlackRock، إن الترميز يقف "تقريباً عند المرحلة التي كان عليها الإنترنت في عام 1996" — وهو وصف دقيق لحالة هذه الفئة من الأصول.
العقارات: إمكانات هائلة لكن التبني بطيء
على الرغم من أن العقارات كانت تُروَّج لها كحالة الاستخدام الأكثر إثارة للترميز، إلا أن الواقع أكثر تعقيداً. لا يزال حجم العقارات المرمزة صغيراً عند نحو 457 مليون دولار فقط، بل وتراجع منذ بداية 2026. هذا لا يعني فشل الفكرة، بل يعكس تحديات تنظيمية وقانونية أكبر مقارنة بالأدوات المالية.
ومع ذلك، هناك مبادرات جادة على أرض الواقع. أطلقت دائرة الأراضي والأملاك في دبي المرحلة التجريبية من مشروع الترميز العقاري، بالتعاون مع هيئة تنظيم الأصول الافتراضية ومؤسسة دبي للمستقبل. وتتوقع الدائرة أن تصل قيمة العقارات المرمزة إلى 60 مليار درهم (16.34 مليار دولار) بحلول 2033، أي ما يعادل 7% من إجمالي المعاملات العقارية في الإمارة. كما شهدت دبي بيع أول حصان سباق مُرمز بالكامل بقيمة 3.2 مليون دولار من خلال شركة Tokinvest، مما يظهر أن الترميز يتجاوز العقارات التقليدية إلى أصول فريدة.
السلع والائتمان الخاص: تنويع متزايد
بعيداً عن سندات الخزانة والعقارات، يشهد السوق تنوعاً ملحوظاً. بلغت السلع المرمزة 8.3 مليارات دولار، بقيادة الذهب المرمز (XAUT وPAXG) بقيمة إجمالية تصل إلى 4.5 مليار دولار. كما دخلت سلع أقل تقليدية مثل اليورانيوم: رمز xU3O8 يمثل ملكية جزئية لليورانيوم الخام الفعلي، بقيمة سوقية تبلغ 9 ملايين دولار، مما يفتح فئة أصول كانت حكراً على المؤسسات الكبرى.
الائتمان المدعوم بالأصول هو الفئة الأكبر بقيمة 23.7 مليار دولار، لكنه يهيمن عليه نشاط HELOC الخاص بشركة Figure، مع توزيع محدود على السلسلة. هذا يشير إلى أن الترميز في مجال الائتمان لا يزال في مرحلة انتقالية بين النماذج التقليدية واللامركزية.
أقوى العملات والمنصات الرائدة في مجال RWA
المنصات المهيمنة حسب قيمة الأصول المرمزة
وفقاً لبيانات RWA Foundation، تتصدر المنصات التالية السوق:
المنصة قيمة الأصول المرمزة Securitize 4.31 مليار دولار Ondo Finance 3.68 مليار دولار Circle 3.13 مليار دولار Franklin Templeton 2.50 مليار دولار Tether Holdings 2.42 مليار دولار
Securitize هي المنصة الرائدة على الإطلاق، وتتميز بتقديم مجموعة كاملة من الخدمات المنظمة تشمل وكيل التحويل والوسيط وبدائل نظام التداول. هذا التركيز على الامتثال الكامل يجعلها الخيار الأول للمؤسسات التي تريد ترميز أصولها دون التعامل مع تعقيدات DeFi أو مخاطر السيولة.
Ondo Finance هي المنصة "الخالصة" الأكثر شمولاً في مجال RWA. منتجها الرئيسي OUSG يوفر وصولاً مرمزاً لسندات الخزانة الأمريكية قصيرة المدى، بينما USDY يعمل كبديل مولد للعائد للعملات المستقرة التقليدية. تجاوزت قيمة الأصول المقفلة في المنصة 2.75 مليار دولار في بداية 2026، وتسيطر على أكثر من 70% من حصة السوق بين مصدري الأسهم المرمزة عبر منصتها Ondo Global Markets.
الرموز الرائدة للمستثمرين
إذا كنت تتطلع إلى الاستثمار في هذا القطاع، فإليك أبرز الرموز التي تحظى بأساسيات قوية في 2026:
Ondo Finance (ONDO): الرمز الأكثر مباشرة للتعرض لقطاع RWA. القيمة السوقية حوالي 2.19 مليار دولار. المخاطرة الرئيسية هي الجدول الزمني لفتح الرموز الكبير عبر 2026-2028، مما قد يخلق ضغطاً هبوطياً على السعر.
Chainlink (LINK): البنية التحتية التي تشغل ثورة RWA. Chainlink لا تصدر أصولاً بنفسها، بل توفر البيانات الحقيقية الآمنة التي تعتمد عليها جميع بروتوكولات RWA الرئيسية. تشغل أكثر من 80% من جميع بروتوكولات RWA، وتؤمن التحقق من الأسعار خارج السلسلة لمليارات الدولارات من الأصول.
Stellar (XLM): شبكة تركز على المدفوعات والتسوية، وتستفيد من الطلب على نقل الأصول المرمزة عبر الحدود.
MANTRA (OM): منصة متخصصة في ترميز الأصول الواقعية مع التركيز على الأسواق الناشئة والامتثال التنظيمي.
Centrifuge (CFG): رائدة في ترميز الائتمان الخاص والأصول غير السائلة، مع بنية تحتية متكاملة لدمج التمويل اللامركزي مع الاقتصاد الحقيقي.
كيف يدعم الترميز سوق الكريبتو؟
جسر بين التمويل التقليدي واللامركزي
القيمة الأكبر التي يقدمها RWA لسوق الكريبتو هي الشرعية المؤسسية. عندما تطلق BlackRock صندوق BUIDL بقيمة تتجاوز 2.5 مليار دولار، وعندما يدخل JPMorgan وFranklin Templeton السوق، فإن هذا يغير بشكل جذري الطريقة التي ينظر بها المؤسسات المالية التقليدية إلى البلوكشين. لم يعد الكريبتو "ذلك الشيء الغريب"، بل أصبح البنية التحتية المالية للجيل القادم.
تدفقات رأس مال حقيقية
الأصول المرمزة تجلب سيولة مؤسسية حقيقية إلى سوق الكريبتو. الأموال التي تدخل في سندات الخزانة المرمزة، وصناديق السوق النقدية المرمزة، وبروتوكولات الائتمان، هي أموال من الاقتصاد الحقيقي. عندما يشتري مستثمر تقليدي رمزاً يمثل سند خزينة أمريكي، فإنه يضخ سيولة في النظام البيئي للبلوكشين دون بالضرورة أن يكون مقتنعاً بالعملات الرقمية كفئة أصول في حد ذاتها.
حالات استخدام عملية للعملات المستقرة
معظم عمليات الترميز تتم باستخدام العملات المستقرة كعملة تسوية. عندما يشتري مستثمر رمز عقار أو سند باستخدام USDC، أو عندما توزع العقود الذكية عوائد إيجارية بعملات مستقرة، فإن هذا يخلق طلباً حقيقياً واستخداماً عملياً للعملات المستقرة يتجاوز التداول المضاربي.
بنية تحتية جديدة للمشاريع
قطاع RWA يخلق طلباً على بنية تحتية متخصصة: أوراكل للبيانات الحقيقية (مثل Chainlink)، شبكات بلوكشين سريعة ورخيصة (مثل Solana وAvalanche)، منصات امتثال وحفظ أمني، وأدوات تحليل وتقييم. هذا يخلق فرصاً لمشاريع الكريبتو التي تقدم هذه الخدمات، ويعمق النظام البيئي بشكل عام.
التحديات التي تواجه الترميز
رغم النمو المثير للإعجاب، يواجه قطاع RWA تحديات جوهرية. الوصول محدود: 97% من القيمة المرمزة للأصول تقع خارج نطاق وصول المستثمرين الأفراد في الولايات المتحدة. فقط 3% من السوق، حوالي 1.7 مليار دولار، يمكن الوصول إليها عبر هياكل قانون 1940. الجزء الأكبر محبوس خلف قنوات مؤسسية خاصة أو أطر خارجية أو قواعد المستثمرين المعتمدين.
التنظيم غير موحد: بينما تقدم سويسرا وسنغافورة والاتحاد الأوروبي أطراً واضحة نسبياً، لا تزال الولايات المتحدة في حالة من عدم اليقين التشريعي. 39% من قيمة السوق لا تمتلك إطاراً تنظيمياً محدداً.
الهيمنة المؤسسية: السوق يهيمن عليه لاعبون كبار، مما يحد من فرص المشاريع الأصغر واللامركزية. هذا قد يحد من الابتكار ويركز القوة في أيدي قلة من المؤسسات.
الخلاصة
ترميز الأصول بالبلوكشين في 2026 هو قصة نجاح حقيقية، لكنها قصة غير مكتملة. سندات الخزانة أثبتت الجدوى، والعقارات لا تزال تنتظر اختراقاً تنظيمياً حقيقياً. المنصات الرائدة مثل Securitize وOndo Finance تبني البنية التحتية التي ستشكل مستقبل الأسواق المالية، بينما الرموز مثل ONDO وLINK توفر للمستثمرين فرصاً للمشاركة في هذا التحول.
الأهم من ذلك، RWA يقدم لسوق الكريبتو ما كان ينقصه بشدة: حالات استخدام حقيقية، وتدفقات رأس مال مؤسسية، وشرعية تنظيمية. إذا كان 2025 هو العام الذي بدأ فيه الترميز يثبت جدواه، فإن 2026 هو العام الذي بدأ فيه يتحول من تجربة إلى جزء لا يتجزأ من البنية التحتية المالية العالمية. التحدي الأكبر الآن هو جعل هذه الفوائد متاحة لقاعدة أوسع من المستثمرين، وليس فقط للنخبة المؤسسية.

$ETH #ETH  Drawdowns in a strong market often reveal the true underlying support more clearly than a rapid acceleration rally. Currently, the 1-hour change is -0.05% and the 24-hour change is +2.55%; we need to determine whether this is a normal cooldown or a structural weakening.

At present, the 1-hour -0.05% and 24-hour +2.55% periods have not formed a sufficiently clear, aligned cooperation in the same direction. In a range-bound market, the tolerance for chasing and stoping out is low. It’s more suitable to confirm direction using the upper boundary and confirm support using the lower boundary, with the midline used only as the line between strength and weakness.

The 1-hour chart has already shown a pullback. First, watch whether 2,369.11 forms stable support. If the price can quickly reclaim 2,424.55, it indicates the pullback is still controllable. If the rebound lacks strength and the low keeps shifting lower, then you can’t keep using the bullish logic.

For the next path, handle it in three ways: if price moves up and effectively holds above 2,479.99, wait for a pullback that doesn’t break and then reassess whether the move can continue; if price breaks down through 2,369.11, prioritize controlling risk and wait for new support; if it continues to consolidate around 2,424.55, treat it as rotation within the range and don’t repeatedly chase direction in the middle.

Position sizing needs to differentiate between spot and derivatives. For existing spot holdings, manage in segments around key levels without frequently switching your stance due to a single 1-hour candlestick. If you’re in cash/flat, wait for confirmation and scale in more calmly. Derivatives place more emphasis on the entry location and the invalidation conditions. When volatility increases, proactively reduce position size to avoid turning short-term judgment into passive holding.

The key focus of derivatives isn’t predicting every single candlestick, but ensuring you have a basis for entering, trimming, and exiting. If there’s no confirmation, do less. If a key level fails, redo the plan—first control the risk per trade, and only then talk about the upside/downside room.

title: 🎯 Guía Express: La Regla del 1% para Proteger tu Capital
subTitle:
El mayor error de un trader novato no es entrar mal al mercado; es gestionar mal la pérdida. Si pierdes tu capital, quedas fuera del juego.

La regla del 1% es la herramienta fundamental para sobrevivir y mantenerte consistente a largo plazo.

📉 ¿En qué consiste?
Nunca arriesgues más del 1% del saldo total de tu cuenta en una sola operación.

Arriesgar el 1% no significa usar solo el 1% de tu saldo para abrir la posición. Significa que, si el precio toca tu Stop Loss, la pérdida máxima permitida será equivalente al 1% de tu cuenta total.

📊 ¿Cómo calcularlo?
Determina tu riesgo máximo:

Si tu capital es de $1,000 USD → Tu riesgo máximo por trade es $10 USD.

Ubica tu Stop Loss en el gráfico:

Analiza la estructura técnica antes de entrar y define la distancia entre tu precio de entrada y tu Stop Loss (ejemplo: un 5% de distancia).

Calcula el tamaño de la posición:

Divide tu monto de riesgo ($10) entre la distancia del Stop Loss (5%).

Tamaño de posición = $10 / 0.05 = $200 USD.

De esta forma, estás operando con $200 USD, pero si el análisis falla, solo perderás los $10 USD calculados.

💡 Por qué cambia tu psicología
10 pérdidas seguidas arriesgando el 1% dejan tu cuenta intacta en un 90%.

10 pérdidas seguidas arriesgando el 10% destruyen casi el 65% de tu capital.

Controlar el tamaño de tu posición elimina la ansiedad y te permite ejecutar tu plan con disciplina.

💬 ¿Qué porcentaje de tu capital arriesgas habitualmente por operación? Te leo en los comentarios.

Ethereum’s upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade clears rehearsal for a big jump in capacity

Ethereum’s latest rehearsal for its Glamsterdam upgrade continued confirming blocks after adopting new block-building rules earlier this week, clearing a key test before a proposed October 6 rollout on the Sepolia public test network.

Nethermind, software used by computers that run Ethereum, followed on Wednesday with a performance test covering one of Glamsterdam’s biggest changes.

Its client completed all 2,302 tests while processing 570.7 billion gas in three minutes and 15 seconds, an average of about 2.9 billion gas per second.

The benchmark measured Nethermind’s execution software rather than the speed of the full network. It tested block-level access lists, which tell Ethereum computers which accounts and stored data a block will use before they begin processing it.

That advance notice lets the computers fetch data and check unrelated transactions at the same time. Ethereum currently processes much of that work in sequence, limiting how much activity it can safely fit into each block.

Glamsterdam raised its block gas limit from 60 million to 200 million about an hour after going live on the testnet. Gas measures the computing work required by transactions, so the higher ceiling creates room for more payments, token swaps and other activity in each block.

How that helps Ethereum
A 200 million limit would let Ethereum absorb more activity before users begin outbidding one another for block space, which could make fee spikes less severe when trading surges or a popular token launch clogs the network.

Larger blocks are also harder to check and could leave smaller operators unable to keep up. Glamsterdam is Ethereum’s attempt to gain that extra capacity without making the chain prohibitively expensive to run.#Write2Earn #Ethereum $ETH

translatedData.content:
To be honest, in the hidden undertow, what we fear most isn’t the lack of signal—it’s when the signal comes out but nobody is willing to verify it. $ETH  At this point, the order book gives me the feeling that bullish sentiment is piled up too much, but the push upward is weaker each time. First, let’s look at the long/short ratio structure. The liquidation intensity on the long side clearly overwhelms the short side—nearly double. What does this distribution mean? Once the price breaks downward through the most recent dense absorption zone, it won’t trigger just stop-losses, but a cascading liquidation. The more crowded the longs are, the more decisive the stampede will be.

On the other hand, the liquidation intensity on the short side is lower, which suggests short positions aren’t heavy. That means there isn’t enough fuel for shorts to get squeezed upward. This creates an asymmetry: dumping down has liquidation leverage as a tailwind, while pulling up lacks the momentum of shorts needing to cover. Next, look at volume. In the recent attempts to test upward, the traded volume has been declining every time. The price makes new highs or comes close to prior highs, but volume doesn’t keep up. This volume-price divergence has become quite obvious on the four-hour timeframe. Without incremental capital to take over, trying to push up using existing positioning alone is something that will eventually fail. The key level below that I’m watching is the lower edge of the earlier consolidation range. If that area is effectively broken down, the liquidation-dense zone will be activated.

Someone might ask: could it fake a breakout first and then dump? That possibility can’t be ruled out, but a fake breakout also needs volume support, and right now we can’t see it. Instead, each rebound’s high point keeps getting lower—this is a pretty typical weak-market structure. From a risk-reward perspective, the upside for chasing longs is limited: resistance layers upon layers overhead, and once the downside breaks, the slippage will be huge. For shorting, the stop-loss reference is the level just above the most recent rebound high, and the risk-reward ratio is reasonable. Of course, if the price puts back on pressure with volume above the resistance level, this logic needs to be reassessed—because the market’s behavior matters more than viewpoints. $ETH

What are these businesses?

Peer-to-peer trading involves individuals buying and selling crypto directly with each other. However, anyone conducting P2P crypto trading by way of business in the UK must have the appropriate FCA registration. Personal P2P transactions do not require registration.

The FCA said there are currently no registered P2P crypto businesses operating in the UK.

2026年9月18日

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间9月18日上午，以太坊现货报价2473美元，过去5小时内从2446美元稳步上涨至2478美元，涨幅约1.31%。从小时K线来看，ETH的上涨节奏比BTC更为平稳，成交量从最初的1105万美元逐步放大至4715万美元，最后一个小时的成交量出现了爆发式增长，说明有大量资金正在入场。

均线系统方面，7日均线2455美元、25日均线2452美元和99日均线2456美元全部位于当前价格下方，形成了非常标准的短期多头排列。7日EMA指数移动平均线2461美元同样被价格突破，表明多头动能正在加速释放。

布林带上轨目前位于2477美元，价格已经触及上轨附近，短期可能面临一定的技术性回调。SuperTrend支撑位在2425美元，这是多头需要关注的下方关键防线。

二、技术指标解读

ETH的技术指标整体偏向多头，与BTC的空头主导格局形成鲜明对比。

MACD方面，柱状图刚刚从负值翻正至0.36，DIF线8.13上穿DEA线7.77，形成了金叉初始形态。虽然金叉力度不如BTC强劲，但方向性信号明确指向多头。RSI指标中，6周期RSI达到81.05，进入超买区域；12周期RSI为70.49，处于中性偏强位置。

KDJ指标表现亮眼，K线64.25、D线50.31、J线92.14，三线呈多头发散形态，J值虽然偏高但尚未达到极限区域，说明上涨动能仍有一定空间。威廉指标WR为负15.52，同样处于超买区域，需要关注短期回调风险。

从综合因子来看，15个因子中有7个做多、7个做空、1个中性，多空力量基本均衡。但综合指标给出了做多信号，历史胜率高达94.12%，这是一个非常强的多头确认信号。综合指标的历史平均最大收益率为0.88%，说明当前做多信号的可信度较高。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊近期的基本面表现可圈可点。最引人注目的是贝莱德在过去20天内累计买入了15亿美元的ETH，同时新地址购入1715万美元的ETH用于质押，这表明机构对以太坊的长期价值高度认可。此外，安克雷奇数字资产公司新增了对ETH的托管支持，俄罗斯莫斯科交易所也即将推出以太坊永续合约，这些都为ETH的机构化进程增添了新的动力。

风险因素方面，以太坊ETF在过去两天出现了3.66亿美元的资金流出，短期抛压不容忽视。美联储加息带来的流动性收紧同样对ETH构成压力。此外，美国参议院CLARITY法案未能通过，加密监管框架的不确定性仍在延续。

综合来看，ETH的技术面信号比BTC更为健康，综合指标的多头胜率高达94%，叠加贝莱德等机构的持续买入，中期走势值得期待。但短期RSI已进入超买区域，建议关注2480美元上方的阻力突破情况以及2425美元支撑的有效性，逢低布局优于追高。

🚨 #BOJ  RATE DECISION: WHY CRYPTO IS WATCHING 🇯🇵
The Bank of Japan is at the center of global market attention as investors watch for a potential 25-basis-point rate hike to 1.25%.
If confirmed, that would take Japan's policy rate to its highest level since April 1995, marking another major step away from the country's long period of ultra-loose monetary policy.
💴 WHY DOES IT MATTER FOR CRYPTO?
Higher Japanese interest rates can affect the yen carry trade — a strategy in which investors borrow yen at relatively low rates and invest in higher-yielding assets elsewhere.
A stronger yen or further #BOJ  tightening could potentially encourage some investors to reduce carry-trade exposure, creating volatility across global risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
📊 WHAT TRADERS SHOULD WATCH
🔹 BOJ's final rate decision

🔹 Governor Kazuo Ueda's guidance on future hikes

🔹 USD/JPY reaction

🔹 Bitcoin and major altcoin volatility

🔹 Global liquidity and risk appetite
The key issue isn't only the rate itself — future #BOJ  guidance could be just as important for markets.
⚠️ A BOJ rate hike does not automatically mean crypto will rise or fall. Market reaction depends on how much of the decision was already priced in and what the central bank signals about future policy.
📌 Bottom Line:

Japan's monetary policy is becoming increasingly important for global markets. The next major signal to watch is the BOJ's official decision and forward guidance.

title: 币圈玄学周报｜9月18日：乙未日“开执位”逢“忌开市”，水星冲土星把话憋了回去
subTitle:
⚠️ 本文纯属娱乐，不构成任何投资建议。玄学分析仅供下饭，别拿它梭哈。

一、先看看今天的基本盘

今天是2026年9月18日，星期五。

昨天FOMC加息落地后，我们说“利空出尽？反转还需催化剂”。今天打开盘面，催化剂没来，但市场比想象中稳。

#BTC 在7.6万美元上方横盘震荡，现报约76569美元，24小时微涨0.75%，盘中一度升至76663美元。#ETH 报约2450美元，24小时上涨约2%。美股隔夜反弹——道指涨0.61%，标普涨1.14%，纳指涨1.69%，油价和美债收益率双双回落。比特币在美股走强的背景下没有跟涨，也没有下跌，卡在7.6万附近“装死”。

爆仓数据出现了微妙反转。 过去24小时全网清算1.5452亿美元，其中空单爆仓1.1857亿美元，多单爆仓3595万美元。空头爆仓是多头的3.3倍。昨天空头死得比多头多，今天这个比例进一步拉大——空头在被反复碾压。

资金面却在发出相反的信号。Glassnode周报指出，比特币实现市值在连续27天上升后于9月15日首次由升转降，现货比特币ETF在9月8日至14日期间净流出约3.34亿美元。9月15日单日BTC ETF净流出4.504亿美元，为6月24日以来最大规模。链上资金和ETF资金同步放缓，衍生品偏防御，期权市场看跌期权价格持续高于看涨期权。

一句话总结：价格稳住了，但钱在悄悄往外走。
{spot}(BTCUSDT)
二、今天的核心矛盾：日央行加息，全球流动性再抽一根水管

今天有一个被很多人忽略的重磅事件：日本央行利率决议。

市场普遍预计日本央行将加息25个基点，将基准利率从1.0%上调至1.25%。日本首相高市早苗表态称“货币政策由央行负责”，暗示不会干预。日圆在决议前已升至155.98兑每美元。

这意味着什么？

全球最后一个廉价资金的水龙头正在关闭。 日本长期维持超低利率，是全球套利交易（借日元买风险资产）的核心资金来源。日央行加息，意味着套利交易的成本上升，部分资金将从风险资产撤回。这对加密市场来说，不是今天的问题，是未来几周的问题。

叠加昨天FOMC加息25个基点、点阵图显示年内还可能再加一次，全球流动性正在经历“双紧缩”。 美联储从美元端收水，日央行从日元端收水。BTC今天能守住7.6万，已经算是“抗压表现”。

另一个值得注意的信号：美国比特币战略储备法案、CFTC开发者监管政策以及S&P Global收购OpenZeppelin成为今天的市场焦点。监管层面的动作在加速，但方向是“制度化”而非“打压”。Glassnode也指出，当前跌幅仍属有限，下一道关键支撑在短期持有者平均持仓成本所在的7.13万美元。

三、玄学时间：乙未日“开执位”，黄历第三次写好了剧本

查一下今天的黄历：

2026年9月18日，农历八月初八，丙午年丁酉月乙未日。十二建星：开执位。五行：砂石金。冲牛（己丑）煞西。

彭祖百忌： “乙不栽植千株不长，未不服药毒气入肠。”

翻译：乙日不宜栽种植物，种了也长不好；未日不宜服药，吃了反而中毒。

黄历宜：祭祀、修坟、除服、成服、启钻、移柩、余事勿取。忌：开市/开业/开张、入宅、嫁娶、动土、破土、安葬。

“忌开市”三个字，今天第三次出现。

9月15日壬辰日，我们说“危日忌开市，冲高回落已应验”。
9月16日癸巳日，我们说“成日先难后易，CLARITY折戟已应验”。
9月17日甲午日，我们说“甲不开仓财物耗散，加息落地先散后收已应验”。
今天9月18日乙未日，黄历又一次写着“忌开市”。

连续四天，黄历都在说同一件事：别交易。

但今天的“忌开市”和前几天不同。前几天的“忌”对应的是剧烈波动——冲高回落、法案折戟、加息砸盘。今天的“忌”对应的是横盘。价格不动，成交量萎缩，多空双方都不愿意在这个位置下注。

“开执位”的含义是什么？ “开”在十二建星里排第十一，意思是“开放、开始、启动”。但今天的“开”被“忌开市”压制了——想开，开不了。

这不就是当前盘面的写照吗？BTC想突破7.7万，上不去；想跌破7.5万，下不来。“开”的能量被锁在一个很小的箱体里。

凶神方面，今日有九空、五虚、土符。九空主空虚、落空，五虚主虚耗、不实，土符主土气过旺、压制生机。三个凶神叠在一起，配合“忌开市”，盘面想“开”也开不动。
{spot}(ETHUSDT)
四、比特币的八字走到哪一步了？

今天日柱乙未。乙为阴木，未为阴土。 木克土，但乙木是藤蔓之木，克土的力量很弱。未土中藏己土、丁火、乙木——土中有火，火中有木，循环自洽。

结合年柱丙午、月柱丁酉来看：今天是年火（丙午）+ 月金（丁酉）+ 日木土（乙未）。金克木，但丁火透干克金，乙木又生丁火。五行形成一个微妙的闭环：金想克木，木生火，火又克金。

对应到盘面就是：空头（金）想继续打压，但多头（木火）在托底。双方都在消耗，谁也打不死谁。

关键变量在秋分。

秋分在9月23日08:04到来。秋分之后，太阳进入天秤座，金气进入全年最旺的阶段。今天是秋分前的倒数第三个交易日，日柱乙未的“木土”组合，恰好是金气全面接管之前的最后一道“缓冲垫”。

未土生金，乙木被金克。今天盘面的横盘，就是“缓冲”的具象化。 等到秋分金气真正旺起来，BTC是借金生水向上突破，还是被金克木继续压制，到时候见分晓。

五、星象时间：水星冲土星，所有的话都被憋回去了

今天有一个值得重点关注的星象：水星在天秤座对冲逆行中的土星在白羊座。

占星师柒爸的解读是：“水星在天秤座对冲逆行中的土星，容易出现一种感觉：有些话不能随便说，有些决定也不能只考虑自己想不想。沟通中可能遇到阻力，比如对方比较冷淡、严格，事情被否定，回复延迟，流程受限。” 

翻译到币圈：今天的市场“无话可说”。

没有重磅消息，没有明确方向，没有人愿意站出来表态。CLARITY法案折戟的噪音已经消化了，FOMC加息的冲击已经过去了，日央行决议还没出结果。市场进入了一个“沉默期”。

水星代表沟通、信息、交易。土星代表限制、边界、现实压力。水星被土星对冲，意味着信息流动被压制，交易意愿被冻结。

昨天的盘面是“空头比多头死得多”，今天的盘面是“双方都懒得动了”。爆仓总额从昨天的3.46亿美元降到今天的1.55亿美元，降幅超过55%。市场在“收声”。

这个星象的影响期持续到9月下旬。 也就是说，未来一周左右，市场大概率维持“低波动、低成交量、低情绪”的三低格局。直到秋分打破僵局。

六、重点看一个东西：空头还在往上堆，下方是空的

今天清算地图的结构没有变，但空头的拥挤度在上升。

CoinGlass数据显示，75,982美元至83,575美元区间，累计空头清算压力维持在47.9亿美元，而下方67,861美元附近的多头清算规模约20.5亿美元。空头与多头的清算压力比约为2.5:1。

更关键的是：期权市场也在“押注反弹”。 9月18日到期期权的未平仓合约本周增加了22%，其中看涨期权增加30%，看跌期权增加12%。看涨期权的增速是看跌期权的2.5倍。

这意味着什么？

大量资金在赌FOMC落地后BTC会反弹。 他们把仓位建在7.8万上方，等待“利空出尽”行情启动。而空头在7.6万-8.3万区间堆了47.9亿美元的燃料，一旦价格向上突破，将触发大规模空头回补。

但问题在于：现货资金在流出，ETF在净流出，稳定币市值没有增长。 没有增量资金，上方再多的空头燃料也点不着。

盘面结构极度矛盾：衍生品在押注反弹，现货在悄悄撤退。 这种背离通常不会持续太久。要么衍生品把现货拉回来，要么现货把衍生品拽下去。秋分之后，方向会自己选出来。
{spot}(SOLUSDT)
七、玄学操作节奏（仅供娱乐）

今天9月18日（乙未日，开执位，忌开市）：横盘装死已应验。 黄历连续四天说“别动”，今天盘面终于“听话”了——不涨不跌，不爆仓，不表态。玄学建议：继续观察，重点看7.6万收盘能不能守住。 Glassnode说7.67万是“True Market Mean”，BTC已经连续两天收在这个位置下方。如果今天收盘再次失守，市场判断可能从“短暂回调”转向“有效跌破”。

今晚至明天：日央行加息落地。

如果日央行加息25个基点且措辞偏鹰，日圆可能进一步走强，套利交易平仓压力将在未来几周逐步显现。对加密市场的影响是滞后的，不是即时的。 今天盘面不一定会反应，但下周需要警惕。

9月19日-22日：秋分前最后的静默期。 水星冲土星的影响期持续到9月下旬，市场大概率维持低波动。这是“蓄力”，不是“结束”。

9月23日秋分：金气最旺的窗口正式开启。 从五行角度，秋分后金气达到全年峰值，对水属性的加密资产形成最有力的支撑。如果FOMC和日央行的利空已经被充分消化，秋分后的BTC有望借助金气重新挑战7.8万-8万区间。

空头挤压预警：47.9亿美元的空头燃料仍然堆在上方。如果秋分后BTC突然放量突破7.8万，不要惊讶——那是空头清算被点燃的结果。

风水方位提醒：今日冲牛煞西，别面朝正西。财神位在东南，喜神位在西北，福神位在正北。但今日“乙不栽植”，财神也不太管事。今天最该待的方位还是“不动”。

穿衣玄学：今天大吉色是黄色、米色、棕色（五行属土，未日土旺）。次吉色是白色、银色（五行属金，土生金）。不宜穿绿色、青色（五行属木，今日乙木被未土耗泄）。

八、最后说句人话

今天的核心信息只有一句话：市场在收声。

价格横在7.6万，成交量萎缩，爆仓量腰斩，多空双方都不愿意在这个位置下注。水星冲土星把所有人的嘴都堵上了，黄历“忌开市”连续第四天劝你别动。

但沉默不代表平静。 47.9亿美元的空头还在上方堆着，9月18日到期的看涨期权本周增加了30%。有人在赌反弹，有人在等突破，有人在悄悄撤出现货。

乙未日说：开执位，但开不了。
水星冲土星说：话憋回去，等秋分。
清算地图说：上方全是空头尸体，下方一片空旷。

三套系统指向同一个字：憋。

憋到秋分，憋到金气旺起来，憋到有人先忍不住。

明天就是周末了。BTC在周末的流动性通常更差，波动可能更小。该休息休息，该喝茶喝茶。下周秋分见。

⚠️ 再次声明：以上内容纯属娱乐创作，所有玄学分析均不构成投资建议。加密市场波动剧烈，请根据自身风险承受能力独立决策。玄学可以看，但别当真。

title: SHIB单日拉6%，ZEC狂飙9%，这盘面真见底了？
subTitle:
一、发生了什么

今天早上一睁眼,群里的截图就刷屏了。$SHIB 24小时涨了6.25%,价格摸到0.000005。$ZEC 更夸张,直接干了9.42%,冲到1489刀附近。$ETH 倒是稳得很,涨了1.67%,在2457附近磨。

全网贪婪指数56,说高不高说低不低,但这个位置最尴尬。散户刚从上周的暴跌里缓过神来,看到几个老币突然异动,第一反应就是"是不是要反转了"。我跟你讲,每次市场局部反弹的时候,这种声音就特别多。

二、资金在赌什么

这波反弹有个很明显的特征:拉的全是老牌叙事币。$SHIB是Meme老祖宗,$ZEC是隐私币龙头,$ETH就不用说了。资金不去碰新热点,反而回头捡这些老东西,说明什么?

说明大资金在找流动性。新币盘子小、滑点大,机构想进得先有人接盘。老币不一样,筹码分散、深度够,大户可以悄悄吃货而不惊动盘面。$ZEC那个9%的涨幅,你去看看成交量,大概率是几个大户在抢筹,不是散户能推出来的。

但别急着兴奋。局部反弹和趋势反转是两码事。现在$ETH还在2450附近晃,连2600都没站上去,谈反转太早了。这更像是跌多了的技术性修复,不是主力要发动新一轮行情的信号。

三、接下来盯什么

第一件事盯$ETH能不能守住2400。这是这波反弹的生命线,破了的话$SHIB和$ZEC涨多少都得吐回去。第二件事盯$ZEC的成交量,如果明天量缩了价格还在涨,那就是典型的缩量诱多,别去接飞刀。

手上有现货的别慌着卖,但也别在这个位置加仓。想上车的等一波回踩,看支撑稳不稳再说。合约玩家把杠杆压到5倍以内,别拿身家去赌一个还没确认的底部。

四、说句实在的

这市场最坑人的时候,就是局部反弹让你以为春天来了。去年10月那一波,多少人看到反弹就满仓冲进去,结果被套到现在。记住一句话:底是走出来的,不是喊出来的。

兄弟们,你觉得这波是真反弹还是死猫跳?
看多的扣1,觉得还要跌的扣2

subTitle:
قانون الوضوح يتعثر في الوقت الذى قدمت الولايات المتحدة فجأة «خريطة ضرائب» لصناعة التشفير.
في 16 سبتمبر/أيلول، أقرّت لجنة جمع التبرعات بمجلس النواب الأمريكي (مشروع قانون تحديد اليقين الضريبي لأصول رقمية) (H.R.10357) بأصوات 38 مؤيدًا مقابل 5 رافضين، والخطوة التالية تتمثل في تقديمه إلى جلسة مجلس النواب العامة للمداولة.
توقيت الأمر مثير للاهتمام للغاية.
قبل أقل من 24 ساعة فقط، تعرض دفع مجلس الشيوخ لقانون (Clarity Act) الأكثر شمولًا لانتكاسة؛ إذ لم تحصل عملية التصويت الإجرائية إلا على 50 صوتًا مؤيدًا، ولم تصل إلى عتبة الـ60 صوتًا اللازمة للمضي قدمًا.
قانون تنظيمي رئيسي تعثر، وفي المقابل تقدّم مشروع قانون ضريبي بسرعة.
هذا يشير إلى مشكلة واحدة:
موقف الولايات المتحدة من صناعة التشفير (Crypto) ليس ببساطة «دعمًا أو رفضًا»، بل إنها بدأت تدريجيًا بإدخال الـCrypto قطعةً قطعة داخل المنظومة المالية القائمة.
### فما الذي تغيّر هذه المرة بالضبط؟
بعبارة بسيطة: في السابق، كانت حسابات ضرائب كثير من صفقات الـCrypto صعبة للغاية.
شراء العملات وبيعها وتحويلها ودفع رسوم الغاز (Gas) والتعدين والرهان (Staking) وإقرارات الوسطاء… العديد من القواعد كانت إما غامضة، أو تُطبق مباشرةً قواعد الأصول المالية التقليدية، ما يجعل الأمور مزعجة جدًا لكل من المستخدمين العاديين والشركات.
هذه المسودة التشريعية تحاول أن توضح هذه الأمور.
ومن بين أكثر ما يلفت انتباه مستخدمي «سوق العملات» العاديين، مسألة المعاملات الصغيرة والرسوم.
وضعت المسودة حدًا أدنى قدره 10 دولارات للمعاملات الصغيرة، وتمنح تبسيطًا في المعالجة الضريبية لرسوم الشبكات للأصول الرقمية التي تنطبق عليها الشروط، ورسوم المعاملات وغيرها. والهدف هو تقليل كمّ السجلات الضريبية الناتجة عن عمليات على السلسلة بقيمة بضعة دولارات أو عشرات الدولارات
وفي الوقت نفسه، تتناول المسودة أيضًا قواعد الغسل (غسل الصفقات)، والتعدين، والرهان، وإقرارات الوسطاء، والإقراض/الاقتراض باستخدام الأصول الرقمية وغيرها.
يبدو هذا الأمر «ضريبيًا» إلى حد كبير، لكن في الحقيقة هو مهم جدًا بالنسبة للـCrypto.
لأن دخول أي قطاع إلى التيار الرئيسي لا يعني فقط إدراج صناديق ETF وشراء المؤسسات لـBTC.
الأهم هو: عندما يستخدمه الناس العاديون، هل يستطيع النظام القانوني ونظام الضرائب استيعابه؟
### أكبر تأثير على مجتمع «العملات» لا يتمثل في دفع ضريبة أقل
كثيرون عندما يرون حد 10 دولارات، تكون أول ردّة فعل لديهم:
«الولايات المتحدة أصدرت أخبارًا إيجابية جديدة في مجال الضرائب، يعني أن BTC ستنطلق فورًا.»
في الواقع، هذا ليس هو التركيز
الأهم الحقيقي هو أن الولايات المتحدة تتحرك تدريجيًا من «كيفية تنظيم الـCrypto» إلى «كيفية جعل الـCrypto يعمل بشكل طبيعي».
وهذا مرحلتان مختلفتان تمامًا.
منذ بضع سنوات، كانت إحدى أكبر مشكلات الـCrypto هي عدم وضوح القواعد.
البورصات لا تعرف كيفية الامتثال، ولا يعرف الطرف المطور ما إذا كان الأمر يُعدّ ورقة مالية (Security)، ولا تعرف المؤسسات كيفية الدخول، ولا يعرف المستخدم العادي كيف يصرّح ضريبيًا عن أي عملية على السلسلة بالضبط.
الآن، تقوم الولايات المتحدة بإضافة قواعد بشكل منفصل من اتجاهات مختلفة: هيكل السوق، والـStablecoin، والضرائب، والوسطاء، والإبلاغ عن الأصول الرقمية… إلخ.
على الرغم من أن (Clarity Act) واجه تعثرًا حتى الآن، فإن إطار الضرائب لا يزال يتقدم للأمام.
وهذا يعني أن تنظيم الـCrypto في الولايات المتحدة لا يتوقف لأن مشروع قانون واحد تعثر، بل يتم الدفع قدمًا بطريقة أخرى.
### التغيير الثاني: أصبح الـCrypto يشبه أكثر فأكثر «بنيةً تحتية مالية»
قد يكون هذا الجانب أهم من الضرائب نفسها.
في السابق، عندما كنا نتحدث عن الـCrypto، كان الحديث غالبًا عن:
BTC وETH وMEME وDeFi
لكن الآن، أصبحت الكلمات المفتاحية في النقاشات السياسية الأمريكية أقرب إلى التمويل التقليدي:
الأصول، والوسطاء، والإقرارات، والأرباح الرأسمالية، والمشتقات، والـStablecoin، والمدفوعات، والتسوية/المقاصة.
بل وحتى قواعد غسل الصفقات بدأت تمتد لتشمل الأصول الرقمية.
والمنطق الكامن خلف ذلك بسيط في الحقيقة:
عندما يكبر حجم الـCrypto أكثر فأكثر، لن يكون من الممكن أن يبقى دائمًا في منطقة رمادية كـ«أصل خاص».
كما أن تصريحات لجنة مجلس النواب الأمريكية الخاصة بجمع التبرعات () واضحة أيضًا: تهدف هذه المسودة إلى جعل معالجة الأصول الرقمية ضريبيًا أقرب إلى معالجة الأصول المالية التقليدية، وفي الوقت نفسه حل المشكلات الضريبية الفريدة للأصول الرقمية.
لذلك، ما يستحق المتابعة مستقبلًا قد لا يكون «هل ستقبل أمريكا الـCrypto أم لا».
بل ما يلي:
بأي طريقة سيتم إدخال الـCrypto في النظام المالي الأمريكي.
## التغيير الثالث: قد تكون الـStablecoin واحدة من أكبر المستفيدين
إذا كان الـCrypto يقترب أكثر فأكثر من البنية التحتية المالية العادية، فستزداد أهمية الـStablecoin.
لأن BTC أقرب إلى «الأصول»، بينما الـStablecoin هي أقرب إلى «واجهة الدولار» داخل النظام المالي.
الدفع، والتحويل، والتداول، وDeFi، وRWA، والتسوية عبر الحدود… في النهاية تحتاج كلها إلى وحدة تسعير مستقرة.
كما أن بدء القواعد الضريبية في إنشاء معالجة أوضح لمدفوعات وتداول الأصول الرقمية يقلّل أيضًا من الاحتكاك لدخول الـCrypto إلى سيناريوهات الاقتصاد الحقيقي.
ولهذا السبب تحديدًا، في السنوات الأخيرة، حظيت الـStablecoin وRWA وTokenized Stocks باهتمام متزايد من المؤسسات.
في السابق، كان الجميع يناقش:
«هل يمكن للعملات أن ترتفع بعد ؟
أما الآن، فربما تصبح مناقشات عدد متزايد من المؤسسات:
«كيف يتم ربط هذه الأصول على السلسلة (on-chain)؟»
وهذا التحول أكثر جدارة بالاهتمام من مجرد دورة صعود/هبوط (bull/bear).
### لكن لا تفهم الأمر على أنه «قريبًا سنشهد طفرة سوق ضخمة»
هنا يجب أن نُطفئ بعض الحماس.
إقرار المسودة عبر اللجنة لا يعني أنها أصبحت قانونًا بالفعل.
بعد ذلك يتعين المرور بمراجعة شاملة داخل مجلس النواب، كما توجد إجراءات تشريعية لاحقة تتعلق بمجلس الشيوخ وغيرها. إضافة إلى ذلك، الوقت المتبقي لدى الكونغرس الأمريكي في هذه الدورة محدود، ولا يزال هناك عدم يقين حول ما إذا كانت المسودة ذات الصلة ستصبح نافذة في النهاية.
لذا لا يمكن تفسير هذه المسألة ببساطة على أنها:
«أمريكا تصدر أخبارًا إيجابية، وBTC ستنطلق فورًا».
قد يكون التأثير الحقيقي يحدث تدريجيًا.
كلما أصبحت القواعد أوضح، زادت سهولة دخول المؤسسات؛
وكلما زادت سهولة دخول المؤسسات، زادت احتمالية ظهور منتجات امتثال (Compliance)؛
وكلما تعددت منتجات الامتثال، انخفضت العوائق أمام المستخدمين العاديين للدخول؛
وأخيرًا قد يتشكل حوض أكبر من الأموال على السلسلة.
هذه سلسلة طويلة من الخطوات.
### بالنسبة للمضاربين العاديين () ما الذي يعنيه ذلك؟
أعتقد أن هناك ثلاث نقاط يجب تذكرها.
أولًا: أصبح الـCrypto أكثر نظامية، لكن هذا لا يعني أن كسب المال سيصبح أسهل.
التنظيم يحل مشكلة ما إذا كان القطاع يمكنه التطور طويل الأمد، وليس ما إذا كان بإمكانك أن تضمن أن الـMEME الذي اشتريته سيرتفع 100 ضعف.
ثانيًا: قد تتركز الفرص مستقبلًا أكثر في «Crypto + المالية».
BTC وStablecoin وRWA وTokenized Stocks والمشتقات على السلسلة والمدفوعات… قد تكون هذه الاتجاهات أكثر جدارة بالملاحظة على المدى الطويل من مجرد السرديات المتداولة في السوق.
ثالثًا: غالبًا ما لا تأتي «الطفرة الحقيقية» في القطاع في يوم خروج السياسة.
السياسات تضع الطريق فقط.
أما الفرص الكبيرة الحقيقية، فعادةً ما تحدث بعد أن تبدأ البنية التحتية والتمويل والمستخدمون والتطبيقات بالنمو معًا.
لذلك، في هذه المرة، مسودة ضريبة الولايات المتحدة، أميل أكثر إلى اعتبارها «إشارة»:
الـCrypto يتحول من «صناعة جديدة تحتاج إلى تنظيم» ببطء إلى «سوق جديدة تحتاج إلى إدراجها في قواعد التمويل».
وبين هاتين الهويتين، يكون الفرق كبيرًا جدًا.
في السابق كنا نراقب يوميًا: أي عملة سترتفع إلى البورصة، وأي مشروع سيقوم بعملية Airdrop، وأي MEME قد يصل إلى 100 ضعف.
أما الآن فقد يتعين تغيير زاوية النظر:
من يضع القواعد؟ من الذي يربط رأس المال؟ من الذي ينقل الأصول التقليدية إلى السلسلة؟
لأن الجولة القادمة من الأموال الكبيرة قد لا تبدأ من MEME 
الأرجح أنها ستبدأ من بنية تحتية مالية جديدة

title: 美国开始给Crypto“上户口”了
subTitle:
Clarity Act卡住后，美国却突然给加密行业送来了一份“税收地图”。

9月16日，美国众议院筹款委员会以38票赞成、5票反对，通过《数字资产税收确定性法案》（H.R.10357），下一步将提交众议院全院审议。

时间点非常有意思。

就在不到24小时前，参议院推动更全面的《Clarity Act》受挫，程序性投票只有50票支持，没能达到推进所需的60票门槛。

一个监管大法案卡住了，另一个税收法案却快速推进。

这说明一个问题：

美国对加密行业的态度，并不是简单的“支持或者反对”，而是在开始一块一块地把Crypto塞进现有金融体系。

### 这次到底改了什么？

简单说，就是以前很多Crypto交易，在税务上很难算。

买币、卖币、转账、支付Gas、挖矿、质押、经纪商申报……很多规则要么模糊，要么直接套用传统金融资产的规则，导致普通用户和企业都很麻烦。

这份法案试图把这些事情说清楚。

其中最容易被普通币圈用户关注的，是小额交易和手续费问题。

法案设置了10美元的小额门槛，对符合条件的数字资产网络费、交易费等提供税务处理上的简化，目的就是减少为了几美元、几十美元的链上操作而产生大量税务记录。

同时，法案还涉及洗售规则、矿业、质押、经纪商申报、数字资产借贷等问题。

这看起来很“税务”，但实际上对Crypto非常重要。

因为一个行业真正进入主流，不只是ETF上市、机构买BTC。

更重要的是，普通人用它的时候，法律和税务系统能不能接得住。

### 对币圈最大的影响，不是少交一点税

很多人看到10美元门槛，第一反应可能是：

“美国又发利好了。”

其实这不是重点。

真正重要的是，美国正在逐渐从“怎么管Crypto”，走向“怎么让Crypto正常运转”。

这是两个完全不同的阶段。

过去几年，Crypto最大的问题之一就是规则不确定。

交易所不知道怎么合规，项目方不知道什么属于证券，机构不知道怎么进入，普通用户也不知道某笔链上操作到底该怎么报税。

现在，美国正在分别从市场结构、稳定币、税收、经纪商、数字资产申报等不同方向补规则。

虽然《Clarity Act》目前受挫，但税收框架仍然在往前走。

这意味着美国的Crypto监管并没有因为一个法案受挫就停止，而是在换一种方式推进。

### 第二个变化：Crypto正在越来越像“金融基础设施”

这一点可能比税收本身更值得关注。

以前我们谈Crypto，更多是在谈：

BTC、ETH、MEME、DeFi、交易所。

但现在美国政策讨论的关键词越来越像传统金融：

资产、经纪商、申报、资本利得、衍生品、稳定币、支付、清算。

甚至连洗售规则都开始向数字资产延伸。

这背后的逻辑其实很简单：

当Crypto的规模越来越大，它就不可能永远停留在一个“特殊资产”的灰色地带。

美国众议院筹款委员会自己给出的说法也很明确：这份法案希望让数字资产与传统金融资产在税务处理上更加接近，同时解决数字资产独有的税务问题。

所以未来真正值得关注的，可能不是“美国会不会接受Crypto”。

而是：

Crypto会以什么方式被纳入美国金融体系。

### 第三个变化：稳定币可能是最大的受益者之一

如果Crypto越来越接近正常金融基础设施，那么稳定币的重要性会继续上升。

因为BTC更像资产，稳定币则更像金融体系里的“美元接口”。

支付、转账、交易、DeFi、RWA、跨境结算，最后都需要一个稳定的计价单位。

而税务规则开始为数字资产支付和交易建立更清晰的处理方式，也是在降低Crypto进入真实经济场景的摩擦。

这也是为什么最近几年，稳定币、RWA、Tokenized Stocks这些东西越来越受到机构关注。

以前大家讨论的是：

“币还能不能涨？”

以后越来越多机构讨论的可能是：

“这些资产怎么上链？”

这个变化，比单纯一个牛熊周期更值得关注。

### 但别把这件事理解成“马上大牛市”

这里必须泼一盆冷水。

法案通过委员会，不等于已经成为法律。

接下来还要经过众议院全院审议，并涉及参议院等后续立法程序。而且美国国会本届剩余立法时间有限，相关法案能否最终落地，目前仍存在不确定性。

所以这件事不能简单理解成：

“美国出利好，BTC马上起飞。”

真正的影响可能是慢慢发生的。

规则越清楚，机构越容易进入；

机构越容易进入，合规产品越容易出现；

合规产品越多，普通用户进入的门槛越低；

最后才可能形成更大的链上资金池。

这是一个很长的链条。

### 对普通“韭菜”来说，意味着什么？

我觉得有三点值得记住。

第一，Crypto越来越正规，但并不意味着赚钱越来越容易。

监管解决的是行业能不能长期发展的问题，不是保证你买的MEME能不能涨100倍。

第二，未来的机会可能越来越集中在“Crypto+金融”。

BTC、稳定币、RWA、Tokenized Stocks、链上衍生品、支付，这些方向可能比单纯炒叙事更值得长期观察。

第三，真正的行业红利，往往不是政策出来当天发生的。

政策只是把路铺出来。

真正的大机会，通常发生在基础设施、资金、用户和应用开始一起增长之后。

所以这次美国税收法案，我更愿意把它看成一个信号：

Crypto正在从“一个需要被监管的新行业”，慢慢变成“一个需要被写进金融规则的新市场”。

而这两种身份之间，差别非常大。

过去我们天天盯着哪个币要上交易所、哪个项目要空投、哪个MEME可能百倍。

接下来可能要换一个视角：

谁在制定规则？谁在接入资金？谁在把传统资产搬到链上？

因为下一轮真正的大资金，未必会从一个MEME开始。

它更可能从一条新的金融基础设施开始。

translatedData.title: The U.S. is starting to “register” Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
After the Clarity Act got stuck, the U.S. suddenly delivered a “tax map” to the crypto industry.

On September 16, the U.S. House Committee on Ways and Means passed the (Digital Asset Taxation Certainty Act) (H.R.10357) by a vote of 38 in favor and 5 against. The next step is to submit it to the full House for consideration.

The timing is very interesting.

Less than 24 hours earlier, the Senate's push for a more comprehensive (Clarity Act) fell short: a procedural vote received only 50 votes in support, failing to reach the 60-vote threshold needed to move forward.

One regulatory bill got stuck, while another tax bill advanced quickly.

Letting the White House hand AI over to businesses to manage themselves—what is the real cost of speeding up innovation?

💡 Impact assessment: Neutral to mildly bullish, but pricing of regulatory risk hasn’t started yet

According to Crypto Briefing, Kevin Hassett, chairman of the White House National Economic Council, publicly stated: the key to addressing AI threats lies in the private sector, not government regulation. In plain terms—when it comes to AI safety, the government plans to have companies self-check and self-correct, and let things run first.

What’s going on

Hassett’s logic is straightforward: if the government regulates too tightly, it will slow innovation. For the U.S. to stay ahead in the global AI race, it needs corporate self-discipline plus market competition to correct course. This continues the current administration’s long-standing approach of loosening restraints on the tech industry.

One-sentence translation: AI innovation floors the accelerator, and the regulator isn’t installing the brake—for now.

Market impact

Short term: For Crypto-related AI sectors, this is likely sentiment-positive because “looser regulation” leaves more narrative room. But looking at the price action, BTC is currently $75,790.12 (24h -1.89%), ETH is $2,398.63 (-3.37%), and XRP is weaker at $1.29 (-7.98%). The entire market is trading on shrinking volume, and this news can’t rescue the chart.📉

Medium term: The AI narrative and Crypto’s computing power and DePIN concepts are becoming more tightly linked. Private-sector leadership means the imagination space for the Nvidia industrial chain and compute tokens is still there. But the risk is also obvious—if one day there’s a major AI safety incident, regulators will “catch up” with thunderous force, and the ones getting hit won’t be limited to AI companies.

My take

I’m 70% bullish on this direction: during the deregulation cycle, the AI + Crypto narrative won’t be disproven. If BTC holds the $75,000 area, the medium-term structure should remain intact. The remaining 30% risk is overall risk appetite across the market—right now ETH is falling more than BTC, and altcoins are broadly down. That suggests capital is withdrawing, and narrative positives aren’t strong enough to offset liquidity contraction.

I’m only watching this direction with a small position; if I’m wrong, I’d take light punishment.

Tom Lee Says AI Debt Is an Opportunity, Not a Bubble: Can the Bull Case Really Be Trusted This Time?

Tom Lee Goes Public: The AI debt is for infrastructure investment, not a bubble—supporting tech stocks and risk-asset sentiment.

According to Crypto Briefing, Fundstrat’s Tom Lee is back with another bout of market encouragement. His core logic is this: the money tech companies are pouring into AI looks like massive debt, but in reality it’s infrastructure investment—like building railroads and laying fiber optics back then. In the short term it’s liabilities, but in the long term it becomes productivity. So don’t panic—this isn’t a replay of the 2000 dot-com bubble.

Put simply, it boils down to one translation: Lee believes the borrowed money is being spent on places that can generate returns, not burned as a sunk cost.

But honestly, I’ve seen this kind of argument too many times. During every bubble’s formation, someone stands up and says, “This time is different.” In 2000, people also said fiber was infrastructure.

Market impact
Short term: a sentiment tailwind. Lee has significant pull in Wall Street; these calls can keep tech stocks and high-beta assets like BTC alive. But right now, BTC is at $75,826 and down 1.92% over the past 24 hours; ETH is at $2,399 down 3.42%; and XRP is down nearly 8%—the market clearly isn’t buying it. Talk is talk, while the money is still flowing out.

Medium term: if AI debt actually starts to default, or if capital expenditures by tech giants are forced to shrink, risk assets will get collectively cut—BTC won’t be able to stay on the sidelines.

My take
I lean toward waiting and staying cautious. Lee’s logic isn’t wrong, but the timing is questionable: the premise of “debt as infrastructure” only holds if cash flow can carry companies through to the harvest period. Current market sentiment is weak; BTC has been grinding around the 75K area. If it breaks below that level, there’s plenty of downside room. I’m about 70% confident in this view; the remaining 30% I leave to the market. I’ll just observe with a small position.

📰 Why does Zcash want to learn Bitcoin’s halving? Miners under pressure?

The Zcash community vote supports faster transactions and a Bitcoin-style halving, but it may reduce miners’ profits and affect network health. This decision could change Zcash’s future and align with Bitcoin’s halving cycle.

Why is this news important?
The core of this story is that Zcash wants to align with Bitcoin and take a path of faster transactions and a fixed halving schedule. But there’s a major hurdle behind it—miners may end up losing money. Bitcoin’s halving works because the coin price rises to offset it, but with a cryptocurrency like Zcash, if transaction fees and the coin price aren’t strong enough, miners will simply leave. That means Zcash either needs to improve transaction speed or find a way to keep the coin price steadier; otherwise, the mining chain becomes unstable. Simply put: Zcash wants to learn from the big brother Bitcoin, but it forgot Bitcoin’s moat—strong market recognition.

Impact on the market
This doesn’t significantly affect the broader landscape of other crypto markets, since Zcash is relatively small. But there’s a subtle effect: if Zcash succeeds, other altcoins may also follow suit to optimize transaction speed, turning it into a technological race. For BTC and ETH, this is just a minor blip, but if Zcash truly gets the halving right, it could serve as a reference for technical iteration across the wider L2 network. Similar historical event? Bitcoin’s halving in 2012 was a turning point from chaos to maturity.

Trading approach

💡 I think in the short term it won’t have much impact on the big pie (BTC) or Ethereum. But if Zcash really speeds up transactions, in the future it may draw more attention from Bitcoin users who don’t want to pay such high fees. If Zcash’s price can hold steady after the halving— or even rise— then more small-cap coins may try to follow. But if miners find they can’t mine profitably, then Zcash’s plan may need to be changed quickly.

If, in the future, Zcash’s transaction speed increases but the coin price crashes, then this assessment is invalid.

深度解读

为什么这条新闻重要？

说白了，这就是当下市场情绪的显微镜：一笔内部转账能让全网警报，说明大家都在找“谁在卖”的证据。XRP今天跌7.66%，是主流币里最惨的，恐慌情绪本来就在找出口，大额转账正好成了情绪放大器。

对市场的影响

链上数据如果是内部划转，短期抛压逻辑就不成立，XRP这7.66%的跌幅更多是情绪杀而非筹码杀。BTC $75,955.51 跌1.95%、ETH $2,406.5 跌3.39%，XRP是放大版下跌，属于高Beta币种的正常表现。中期看，交易所托管架构调整（冷热钱包分离、审计准备）反而是合规化信号。

操作思路

- 币种：XRP为主，BTC/ETH情绪联动

This South Asian country is a net oil importer—each time oil prices rise, the import bill grows thicker, and foreign exchange reserves are being drained continuously. Impact on the market

Retail investors in high-inflation economies like Sri Lanka and Turkey have historically been an important source of crypto buying—this liquidity is shrinking.

- Short term: risk appetite weakens. BTC $75,923.67 (24h -1.96%), ETH $2,405.93 (-3.28%) are already reflecting it, as funds rotate into safer assets. In one sentence: oil prices are not the direct hammer that knocks the market down—they’re the pipe that gradually drains it.
- Medium term: if crude oil really charges to a new historical high with a 15.5% probability, global inflation expectations restart and the Fed’s room for rate cuts gets squeezed. That would be a steady drag on crypto valuations—worse than a single-day -2% drop.

My view
In the short term, I’m bearish. We’ll need to see whether BTC can hold the support around $73K. If it breaks, downside room opens up. One-sentence translation: What used to be visible everywhere when you used your holdings for DeFi lending is now something you can hide—and apparently $40 million of money is already willing to lock for it.

In-depth analysis

Why is this news important?

The core logic is the conflict between on-chain transparency and institutional demand. One thing traditional hedge funds and market makers fear most when entering DeFi: strategies going “naked.” If your vault address is公开, counterparties can simply target your positions. Zama uses fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) to encrypt positions—this is the prerequisite that lets institutional capital truly step in.

Looking at it in a broader cycle, it’s even more interesting: BTC $75,898（24h -2.37%）, ETH $2,404.74（-3.83%）show weak market sentiment, but infrastructure financing and product iteration are actually accelerating. In the short term, it has almost no impact on BTC/ETH prices—this is infrastructure news, not capital-flow news. But in the medium term, the scale of privacy vaults is a leading indicator of institutional willingness to enter. If these vaults climb from $40 million to the hundreds of millions quickly, it suggests “smart money” is quietly building positions in a weak market—hiding specifically because it doesn’t want to be followed.

Downside risk: privacy infrastructure has long been a regulatory-sensitive area, and the lesson from Tornado Cash is still fresh. If regulators move against confidential vaults, this narrative is immediately cut in half.

韩国副总理兼财长提名人李亨一在国会听证会上说，虚拟资产税对大多数投资者只会造成“有限负担”。据 ChainCatcher，他给了两个关键数据：约95%的投资者持仓不到500万韩元（大概3千多美元），根本够不着起征点；而且无法证明买入成本时，收入的一半可以直接算作必要费用，另有250万韩元基本扣除。

简单说：韩国这轮加密税主打一个“抓大放小”，散户几乎免税，真正的税负砸在大户和机构头上。

- 短期：利多。韩国是加密活跃度最高的市场之一，此前市场一直担心新税重挫散户交易热情，现在悬念落地，情绪面修复。今天BTC在$75,776附近、ETH在$2,400一线的下跌，更多是整体风险偏好问题，这条消息至少托住了韩元交易对的卖压。

我的判断
我站利多这边，这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给市场。税制悬念落地属于典型的“靴子落地”行情，BTC $75,776这个位置如果能守住，反弹空间比继续下探的概率大。ETH $2,400今天跌得比大盘狠，弹性也会更大。风险点在于：如果整体宏观风险偏好继续走弱，单一国家利好扛不住，别指望它独立拉盘。说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位试试。

The Fed bought $15.6 billion over three weeks—why this isn’t QE coming back?

The Fed reinvested $15.6 billion over three weeks to purchase bonds, but this is just rollovers at maturity—not liquidity “dumping.” Don’t treat it as a liquidity boost.

According to Crypto Briefing, the Fed made $15.6 billion in reinvestment purchases over the past three weeks. It sounds dramatic, but the gist is this: it’s a natural rollover of maturing Treasuries, so the total size of the balance sheet doesn’t change. This is not QE, not a pivot, and not a “flood the market” signal.

In one sentence: it’s not the Fed turning on the tap—it’s just topping up the swimming pool, and the water level doesn’t rise.

Market impact
- Short term: The voices calling for a “liquidity turning point” can take a breather. BTC fell to $75,776.96, ETH to $2,401.42, and XRP was down 9.28% over 24 hours. This selloff has nothing to do with liquidity, and don’t expect this news to save it.
- Medium term: The Fed maintains a “cautious and do-nothing” stance, suggesting officials are more conservative in their assessment of current market conditions. The balance-sheet runoff isn’t stopping, and there are no signals of rate cuts—so the medium-term liquidity environment remains tight.

My take
This news doesn’t change my view: neutral to bearish. The market’s misreading it as a positive can actually become a small pitfall—when expectations fail, the drop may be smoother. Whether BTC can hold around $75,000 is the key factor for the short term. If it can’t hold, downside room opens up. I’m 70% confident this is a neutral event already digested; the remaining 30% is for the market to decide—if I’m wrong, please go easy on me.

ZEC worth $1,470—do you still dare to chase it?

First, take a look at the surface: the overall market is still grinding, while ZEC has gone crazy.

On September 16, ZEC was still around $1,100. Today it surged to above $1,400, and the latest momentarily came close to $1,470—up 30%+ in two days.

In the past 24 hours, contract trading volume exceeded $12 billion, and short liquidations totaled about $18.7 million.

BTC hasn’t moved much, but ZEC first went in to wipe out the shorts.

The question is: 
At $1,470, is this just the start of a trend, or is it the final baton that the chasing crowd runs for?

First thing: the NU7 upgrade—yes, it really lit a fire under ZEC.
This rally isn’t purely driven by hype.

Zcash recently completed the NU7 governance vote. About 2.4 million ZEC participated, with nearly 99.9% supporting shortening the target block time from 75 seconds to 25 seconds, while maintaining the existing halving mechanism. So this surge has a fundamental catalyst.

But the magnitude is right there too:
From around $800 in early September to nearly $1,500—already close to doubling.
The story is real, and so is the upside.

Second thing: the shorts are forced to surrender, and longs start getting crowded.
Over the past day, ZEC contract trading volume exceeded $12 billion, and OI has reached about $3.5 billion. In the past 24-hour liquidations, shorts made up the majority. The more the price keeps climbing, the more likely it is for new longs to jump in—especially after earlier short sellers keep getting stopped out.

This is the classic squeeze.

But this kind of market is most afraid of:
When only leveraged longs are left.
Once the price turns, the stampede can happen very fast.

Third thing: $1,470 is not a comfortable place to chase longs.

Now focus on three levels:

$1,500—the psychological pressure point.
Only after a breakout with volume and holding above it is there room for further upside.

$1,375–$1,400—the prior breakout zone.
If it pulls back to here and stabilizes, the long-side structure is still intact.

$1,250—an important defense level.
If it breaks down, this acceleration rally will clearly cool off.

Trading strategies
Short-term chasing longs:
I don’t recommend chasing directly around $1,470.
If there’s a breakout with volume above $1,500, then a pullback and holding around $1,450–$1,470—then observe for continuation.

Buy on pullback:
If it falls to $1,375–$1,400 and shows downside stabilization with reduced volume, you can watch for a rebound.

Slightly bearish:
If it pushes up toward $1,500–$1,550, then stalls with volume and also breaks below $1,375, you can watch for a pullback.

9月16日ZEC还在1100美元附近，今天最高冲到1400美元上方，最新一度接近1470美元，两天涨了30%+。

1470美元，现在是趋势刚开始，还是追涨盘最后一棒？

As U.S. Treasury yields near a key inflection point, market volatility is set to be amplified—BTC and ETH have already sold off today as a warning.

According to Crypto Briefing, U.S. Treasury yields are approaching an inflection point. Put simply: if bond yields keep rising, traditional equity/credit hedging strategies will fail. Previously, when stocks fell, you could buy bonds as a safe haven—now bonds are also losing money, and institutions have nowhere else to hide. So people are forced to look for other strategies, and volatility expectations get cranked up directly. Today’s tape already confirmed it: BTC $75,811 down 2.8%, ETH $2,402 down 4.38%, and XRP is even worse—down 9.3%.

One-sentence translation: safe-haven assets aren’t acting safe anymore—every risk asset is lining up again to get sold, with crypto at the front of the queue.

- Short term: As yields approach an inflection point, liquidity expectations tighten, and altcoins break first (SOL -5.4%, XRP -9.3% is the evidence). BTC is relatively more resilient, but if it can’t hold, it will likely catch up with the selloff. Funds will probably move first into T-bills and cash, and the crypto market is taking on very thin volume.
- Medium term: If yields truly move past the point, traditional allocation funds will have to reassess alternative assets—an outcome that’s actually a long-term story for crypto. But in the near term, macro is the only pricing anchor, and sector rotation and narratives have to step aside.

My view

ETH is weaker than the broader market, so don’t expect it to lead the rebound. In the medium term, however, I’m not that pessimistic—after volatility amplifies, it’s often also the starting point of an inflection-point rally, as long as yields top out and then pull back. BTC mining cost $75,500. As the coin price returns to the cost line, why aren’t miners coming back?

💡 Decision factor: Neutral to bearish—price rebounds can’t fix the structural problems in the mining industry

According to The Block and CoinShares’ latest report: In Q2, the pre-tax cash cost to mine one BTC for listed mining companies was about $75,500. And BTC is now $75,811.93, down 2.8% over the past 24 hours.

One-sentence translation: Miners are basically not making much money anymore. The mining rigs that went off to do AI won’t turn back in the short term.

What’s going on

Last year, the AI compute boom was hot. A bunch of mining companies converted their data centers into AI data centers, trying to cash in on the Nvidia ecosystem. Now that the coin price has fallen back to $75,811.93—almost flying just above the $75,500 cost level—mining is theoretically “worth doing” again. But CoinShares’ conclusion is very direct: don’t expect miners to flow back.

The reasons aren’t complicated—AI customers sign multi-year long-term contracts with stable cash flow, while mining revenue depends entirely on the mood of the coin price. Who would tear up an AI contract that’s already locked in for a business that has just returned to breakeven?

Impact on the market

Short term: This news has limited impact on price action. $75,811.93 is also a notoriously fragile emotional zone to begin with. ETH at $2,402.57 and SOL at $97.12 are falling even more, and overall sentiment remains defensive.

If miners don’t return, there’s no incremental selling pressure and no added capacity. Difficulty may stay at low levels going forward.

Medium term: Industry differentiation will accelerate. Mining companies with AI orders are doing fine, while pure-play miners will struggle to profit on the $75,500 cost line. Cutting production, merging, and selling machines are likely next.

This will affect mining company stocks much more than BTC itself.

My view

For BTC’s price itself, this isn’t an additional bearish catalyst so much as it confirms weakness: when the price tracks the industry cost line, it shows buyers aren’t stepping in strongly. I expect the market to keep grinding down in the near term. I’m looking for support around the 70,000 integer level, while resistance on rebounds may be near the 80,000 area.

I have about a 70% confidence in this view. The other 30% goes to the market—I’ll just observe with a small position and, if I’m wrong, I’ll take it lightly.

- Outlook: Neutral to bearish📉 Projected pressure
- Time horizon: 12 hours

一句话翻译：矿工挖币基本不赚钱了，之前跑去搞AI的矿机，短期不会回头。

怎么回事

去年AI算力火热，一堆矿企把机房改造成AI数据中心，想赚英伟达生态的钱。现在币价跌回 $75,811.93，跟75,500的成本几乎贴地飞行，理论上挖矿又“值得”干了。但CoinShares的结论很直接：别指望矿工回流。原因不复杂——AI客户签的是多年期长约，现金流稳定，而挖矿收入全看币价脸色，谁会为了一个刚回到盈亏平衡线的生意，撕掉已经锁定的AI合同？

对市场的影响

短期：这个消息对盘面影响有限，$75,811.93 这个位置本来就是情绪脆弱区，ETH $2,402.57、SOL $97.12 跌得更多，整体还是防御氛围。矿工不回流意味着没有新增抛压，也没有增量算力，算力 Difficulty 后续可能维持低位。

But from another angle, a slowdown in speed might not be a bad thing. If Strive is passively following the equity-raising timetable tied to its stock price (issuing some convertible bonds and buying accordingly), then the reason for the slowdown could be that the financing window is waiting for a better price—not that it’s losing interest.
